item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Detect changes to declared source dependencies.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport json\\n\\n\\n_MISSING = {\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _canonical_json(value):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return a deterministic JSON representation without mutating value.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    return json.dumps(\\n        value,\\n        sort_keys=True,\\n        separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"),\\n        ensure_ascii=False,\\n    )\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Compare saved and current states for non-ignored declared paths.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    ignored = set(policy.get(\\\"ignored\\\", []))\\n    saved = request.get(\\\"saved\\\", {})\\n    current = request.get(\\\"current\\\", {})\\n\\n    changed = []\\n    for path in set(request.get(\\\"declared\\\", [])) - ignored:\\n        saved_state = saved.get(path, _MISSING)\\n        current_state = current.get(path, _MISSING)\\n        if _canonical_json(saved_state) != _canonical_json(current_state):\\n            changed.append(path)\\n\\n    changed.sort()\\n    return {\\\"needs_review\\\": bool(changed), \\\"changed\\\": changed}\\n\"}},{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\",\"content\":\"[\\n  {\\n    \\\"needs_review\\\": false,\\n    \\\"changed\\\": []\\n  }\\n]\\n\"}}]}"}
